title: Hashiriya Battle
tag_line: Night-time expressway career on the Shuto C1: flash a rival, win the SP battle, climb the ranks. ({VERSION})
html:
The city sleeps. The expressway doesn't.

A night-time expressway career for BeamNG.drive on the Shuto Expressway C1. Start with a used car, find rivals cruising in traffic, flash your lights and fight SP battles on the open road. Crews with leaders, lone wanderers, money, fuel, repairs, shops you visit on foot, a home to sleep in and a career that grows with you.

Required: Shuto Expressway C1 map by Ezo, traffic and Japanese plates by AgentMooshroom5.
